北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 30℃，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 30℃. Remember to drink more water!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雨伴 9级阵风，体感 17℃。雨势很大，请务必注意出行安全！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain and 9-level gusts in Ningbo, feels like 17℃. Very heavy rain, please be safe when going out!
宁波.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 9级

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，路面湿滑，出行请慢些，注意安全。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Shanghai, roads are slippery. Drive safely and take it slow.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热 36℃，风力 6级。户外活动注意防晒补水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot 36℃ in Guangzhou with 6-level winds. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云炎热 35℃，体感 34℃。注意防暑，小心热浪。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and hot 35℃ in Shenzhen, feels like 34℃. Take care in the heat!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨伴 8级大风，体感 16℃。风大雨大，出门要保暖防风哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and strong 8-level winds in Hangzhou, feels like 16℃. Stay warm and wind-proof!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨湿度高，体感 25℃。出门带伞，注意防潮。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and high humidity in Nanjing, feels like 25℃. Bring an umbrella, mind the damp.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感高达 38℃！防晒补水是关键，避免中暑。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, feels like a scorching 38℃! Sunscreen and hydration are key.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，风力 6级。虽然体感 29℃，防晒也不能忘哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny with 6-level winds in Wuhan. Although it feels like 29℃, don't forget sunscreen.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 34℃。天气炎热，注意防晒和多喝水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 34℃. It's hot, remember sunscreen and hydration!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 35℃。火炉模式开启，注意防暑降温哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chongqing, feels like 35℃. The 'furnace mode' is on, stay cool!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云宜人 25℃，出门散步很舒服呢。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Pleasant 25℃ and cloudy in Harbin, perfect for a walk outside.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗 30℃，阳光正好。注意防晒，心情美美哒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 30℃ in Shenyang, perfect weather. Remember sunscreen, enjoy your day!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明大雨，体感 12℃。出门带厚衣物和雨具，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain in Kunming, feels like 12℃. Bring warm clothes and rain gear, avoid catching a cold.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降11℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 5级。体感 29℃，出门小心防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Xiamen with 5-level winds. Feels like 29℃, mind the wind when going out.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 30℃。虽然阴天，防晒补水也不要忽视哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Qingdao, feels like 30℃. Even cloudy, don't forget sunscreen and hydration.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 28℃。天气舒适，出门感受海风吧！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels like 28℃. Pleasant weather, enjoy the sea breeze!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，风力 5级。虽然不晒，也要注意补水。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Zhangpu with 5-level winds. Stay hydrated, even if it's not sunny.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雨伴 7级风，体感 20℃，外出请务必带伞、注意保暖防风！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain and strong winds in Cixi, feels like 20℃. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!
